decision.reply_to_employee:
Hi Asha,

Thanks for your claim for 3 nights at The Strand Hotel, London. The receipt is in order. The hotel rate of GBP 265.00 a night is USD 344.50, which is above the USD 320 per night limit for London, so the reimbursable amount comes to USD 960.00 (3 x USD 320). Adding that to the amount already approved for you this month would take you over your monthly expense cap, so I have passed the claim to your manager for a decision. A finance reviewer will make the final decision. You don't need to send anything further unless your manager or Finance asks.

Finance Operations
decision.escalation_reason: Reimbursable USD 960.00 plus month-to-date USD 1980.00 = USD 2940.00 exceeds the USD 2500.00 monthly cap.
